note_en: 由于……所以…… gives a cause and its result, like "because... so...": 由于肉片带皮，所以吃起来才会有肥而不腻的口感 "because the slices keep their skin, they taste rich without being greasy." English uses either "because" or "so" but not both, while Chinese happily pairs them. 由于 is more formal than 因为 and is typical of written explanations like this one.
